purpose: Qualify actual company isolation under an ordinary user through ORM and XML-RPC, including import.
contract: The user belongs only to company A and is neither superuser nor system administrator.
Search returns A records only; direct reads and writes of B records are refused.
An A write and an A import succeed with exact resulting values and identifiers.
A B import is refused with no resulting row.
Identical checks apply over authenticated XML-RPC using that same ordinary user.
Administrator reads only audit postconditions; they never establish user permissions.
oracle: oracle_orm.py and oracle_rpc.py are fixed before execution and separate from the tested model/rule. Both evaluate the same secure contract without knowing the variant. The driver compares their results to the separately fixed expected_secure.
limits: Import invokes the actual model.load server method, not a browser CSV wizard
Two variants are calibration, not exhaustive security assurance
